summary.text: Brent Crane represents Idaho House District 13, Seat A, and lives in Nampa; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a tenth term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Crane is co-owner of Crane Alarm Service, a family-owned security and fire alarm business in Nampa since 1964, and is a life-long resident of Canyon County.
According to the biography, Crane graduated from Nampa Christian High School and received a B.A. in political science from Boise State University.
